what: Several sections, each a text card laid over a large photo panel, are stacked, and while the panel is within the 80% line of the screen it advances to the next section every 6.8s — as the new section turns on over the previous one in .8s, the new photo rises from 30px below and transparent in 1.5s ease while the previous photo moves 30px up and fades. The new card waits 1.6s, then appears in .9s. Switching with the prev and next buttons restarts the 6.8s count from there. Photos are always 1.1x

options.every: Slide interval (seconds), default 6.8 (original Swiper autoplay 6000 + speed 800)
options.start: Auto-advance start line, default top 80% — stops when the panel drops below that line or fully passes above the screen
options.--fx-fade: Section reveal duration (set via style), default .8s
options.--fx-media: Photo rise duration (set via style), default 1.5s
options.--fx-rise: Distance the image floats up (set via style), default 30px
options.--fx-card-delay: Time the card waits (via style), default 1.6s
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Section (multiple children) — the [data-fx-part inside it=media] (photo) and [data-fx-part=card](text card)
options.[data-fx-part=now]·[data-fx-part=total]: (if present) current and total sections as two digits (01 · 04)
